item.description:
Dax 3.4.1

  • Shepherd opens every agent in its terminal. The graphical chat view is paused for this release.
  • The mouse button is back in each pane: switch between scrolling the agent and browsing pane history. ⌘S does the same, and Settings chooses the default for new panes.
  • The browser’s Scoop panel chooses readable text for your accent color, including pale accents and light appearance.
  • Lid-close support is paused. Dax no longer offers helper installation, repair, or lid settings, and setup skips the helper step.
  • Includes the new DaxPro app identity, permission setup, and AI video editor from the prepared 3.4 update.

Upgrading from the earlier Dax app requires installing DaxPro. Existing projects, settings, history, and saved secrets are preserved. The previous app's update feed is unchanged.

This update does not change existing macOS sleep settings. If you previously used Dax to disable sleep, review the recovery guidance in the release notes before removing an older helper.
